entries.title: P0117 primary conjecture and 2026 claim scope (draft)
entries.statement: Damron-Hanson Conjecture 1 asks whether iid continuous nonnegative nearest-neighbor edge weights on Z^2 almost surely admit no bigeodesic, with no moment hypothesis stated there. A public preprint dated 2026-09-24 claims this conclusion when the minimum of four independent weights has finite second moment. This later proof claim has not passed independent full-paper review in this packet. Current openness is UNKNOWN; do not infer that the moment-free conjecture is settled.
assumptions: Conjecture 1 is read in Damron-Hanson's nonnegative Z^2 edge-weight setup
Recent paper is a public claim, not a certified theorem here

source.excerpt: Almost surely there are no bigeodesics in dimension two.

entries.title: P0117 deleted-edge threshold reduction (reviewed draft)
entries.statement: Under iid finite positive nonatomic weights on nearest-neighbor Z^2, fix an edge e={u,v} and condition on all other weights. Let d be the metric with e deleted, C_e(x,y)=min(d(x,u)+d(v,y),d(x,v)+d(u,y)), and H_n=max(0,max_{x,y in S_n}[d(x,y)-C_e(x,y)]) for infinity-norm shells S_n containing e strictly inside. H_n decreases to H_infinity and P(e belongs to a bigeodesic | other weights)=F(H_infinity). Thus absence by this route requires H_infinity<=essential infimum(F) almost surely, which is UNPROVED here. One independent referee KEEP supports only the reduction; second-login review is pending.
assumptions: e fixed, n large enough that e lies strictly inside the shell

entries.title: P0117 fixed-pair shell union obstruction (reviewed draft)
entries.statement: Let S_n be the infinity-norm shell of radius n in Z^2 and q_n=max_{u!=v in S_n} P(0 lies on Geo(u,v)). Under iid atomless weights with the min-of-four second moment condition, a positive norm shape theorem yields a deterministic C>=2 for which (2n+1)q_n+2 sum_{r=n+1}^{Cn}q_r>=1-o(1). Hence q_n cannot be o(1/n) on all scales. The raw bound P(some S_n-pair geodesic through 0)<=min(1,binom(8n,2)q_n) therefore cannot prove vanishing by improving q_n alone. This gives no positive lower bound for the union event. One independent referee KEEP supports this route obstruction; second-login review is pending.
assumptions: iid atomless finite nonnegative nearest-neighbor weights on Z^2
finite second moment of the minimum of four iid weights
positive norm and uniform shape theorem

relations.rationale: The existing card says 'For nondegenerate continuous iid planar passage-time laws ... determine whether a bi-infinite geodesic exists'; the new card quotes the primary conjecture's scope and distinguishes the later moment-restricted proof claim.

The existing card asks whether a bi-infinite geodesic exists; the new card's conditional probability F(H_infinity) is exactly the fixed-edge witness reformulation, with support collapse explicitly unproved.
The existing card asks for absence of bi-infinite geodesics; the new card says the maximum fixed-pair midpoint bound cannot by itself control the all-shell-pair witness union.
